scope: Akemi Iwashita's promise and diary stories in iwashita.ks.

entries.role: Third-year high school student and storyteller
entries.note: Composed, insistent, and ready to turn the listener's own answers against them. The Kiwame story belongs to her own school's past. Preserve the shift into second-person storytelling.

entries.role: Girl in Iwashita's story about a shared diary
entries.note: Quiet and withdrawn. Finds written communication easier than speaking and strongly values the diary exchanged with her boyfriend. Introduce her name only where the original does.

entries.role: Girl from another class who later proposes sharing a diary
entries.note: Quiet and reserved. The story links her appearance with Sano's memory. Preserve its uncertainty about what is real.
Two people take turns writing entries and passing the same diary back and forth. Use diary when the source shortens the term.
Two students share the day's classroom duties. Preserve the paired assignment and distinguish the class log from a personal diary.
The official record of the day's classroom events, contrasted with Sano's personal diary at2593.
Generic realm of spirits. The corridor of endless hell is a description, not an established named location.
